text:
Hello! Your new life starts here.

Use W to walk up, A left, S down, and D right. You can also tap a path to walk.

Come to the green information kiosk and say hello to me. Tap a person or press E nearby to talk. The two passengers are happy to chat too.

You can get an ID card at the tax office. Leave through the south path, then ask the clerk for an ID card. You’ll need it for a bank account or a flat.
